meeting_summary:
{base_prompt}

Analyze the transcript and produce a structured meeting summary in markdown format. Include the following sections (omit any that would be empty):

## Overview
A 2-3 sentence executive summary of the meeting.

## Key Points
Bullet list of the most important discussion points.

## Action Items
Bullet list of follow-up tasks. Include owner and due date if mentioned in the transcript.

## Decisions Made
Bullet list of any decisions reached during the meeting.

Use proper markdown formatting with headers (##) and bullet points (-).

Transcript:
{text}
chunk_extraction:
{base_prompt}

You are extracting structured meeting data from the transcript chunk below. Follow these rules and respond with valid JSON only.

Rules:
1. Output a single JSON object with keys "action_items", "decisions", "key_points", "participants", "topics".
2. Each action item object must include "text", "owner" (string or null), and "due_date" (string or null).
3. Each decision object must include "text" and "context" (string or null).
4. Each key point object must include "topic", "summary" (1-2 sentences), and "participants" (array of names explicitly mentioned).
5. Keep arrays empty ([]) when the transcript does not provide data. Never guess or infer.
6. Do not include markdown, commentary, or trailing commas.

Transcript chunk:
{text}
refine:
{base_prompt}

You are preparing the final meeting summary from the aggregated findings below. Use a professional tone and rely only on the provided data.

Produce sections in this order and omit any that would be empty:
1. Title
2. Executive Summary (2-3 sentences)
3. Key Decisions (bullet list)
4. Action Items (bullet list in the form 'Owner - Action (Due Date)' or 'Unassigned - Action')
5. Discussion Highlights (group bullet points by topic and mention participants)
6. Open Questions (if any)
